1.en_consolidated_definition:
Economic Embargo.

Trade Embargo.

Naval Embargo.

Embargo is a government-imposed prohibition on trade with one or more countries, typically in response to political tensions or economic disputes.

In the context of Puerto Rico, an embargo can also refer to the economic sanctions imposed by the United States on Cuba from 1960 to 1993.
